coverage: All 112 .md at depth<=3 under repos/* were inventoried. CLAUDE.md/README for the live repos were read and checked against the live fleet: activity-api, development-vessel, concept-db, discovery, identity (OPEN-FINDINGS), stateful-ui, human-surface ui, ias-executor, cpg, libp2p and obsidian. The 67 fossil docs in gitignored K8s-era repos (deployment, workbench, terminal, react-renderer, user-vessel, metabob-cloud-dashboard) were only classified in bulk, not read one by one. Everything in .claude was checked: all four hooks (run or log-analysed; the edit gate was measured with the bypass on and off), settings.json and settings.local.json, all 6 skills, the 4 opsx commands, and the MCP config. Live checks covered the listen sockets, discovery registry, memoryNote store, concept-db upkeep and health, goal-host and ribosome journals, the SurrealDB activity tables, and gh CI runs for activity-api and concept-db. Node 2 was only spot-checked (bootstrap, health, image binaries). Not established: when the localhost/IPv6 pasta failure began; the cause of the 09-26 memory loss; whether trace-table ORDER BY results are reliable; a live re-probe of the identity findings. No goal-host docs exist, so its source was only sampled where a doc claim led there.

problems.symptom: Host tools using 'localhost' get a connection reset for vessels bound IPv4-only (8090, 8100, 8260, 8270, 8310), because pasta forwards ::1. This breaks the session-start hook, the edit-gate S3 branch and the MCP goal_status/registry_query. 127.0.0.1 works.
problems.root_cause: Vessels bind hostname 0.0.0.0 (v4-only). Hooks and MCP default to localhost:18xxx and none read the substrate-connect config.

problems.symptom: The authoritative memory store holds 59 notes (oldest 09-26) against 750 cache files. The 680-note store at /workspace/memory/notes.json is still unread.
problems.root_cause: The store lives at a gitignored path inside the super-repo clone, and the EnvironmentFile overrides WORKSPACE_ROOT. The 09-26 loss cause is not established.

problems.symptom: The edit gate exits 0 silently in every session
problems.root_cause: settings.local.json env SUBSTRATE_ALLOW_DIRECT_EDIT=1 persisted since at least 09-06. Transcripts claim it was 'restored to 0 after'.

problems.symptom: The session-end consolidation goal 'reaches' only by reading memoryNote. The pathway is learned as 4/5 reached.
problems.root_cause: No oracle requires a concept-graph write, and the satisfier/floor reach counts a read as a reach

problems.symptom: Every recordGoalPath logs 'Failed to resolve SHA ... 401' (5,015 in 4 days)
problems.root_cause: Autonomous f375f10 added a reader of the unserved shape goal_path_sha with no auth header

principles: Fail-open hooks must emit a visible signal on failure; a silent 0-byte exit reads as 'memory injected' and has hidden an empty teaching channel.
Bind the host-facing channel to one config source (substrate-connect output) and 127.0.0.1 or dual-stack listeners. Fix the seam once instead of fixing each of the four consumers.
Any 'restored/fixed' claim about operator config (bypass env, open findings, merged stores) must be re-measured by state, not recalled from prose.
A goal whose reach can be satisfied by reading the shape it should write is hollow by construction. Consolidation needs a write-side oracle.
Before adding a reader of a shape, confirm a producer exists in the registry; an unserved shape plus a missing auth header produced 17 days of silent 401s.
Validation hardening at a shared seam (discovery register) must be run against every existing caller, including legitimate edge cases like consumer-only vessels with no shapes.
Docs belong to the vessels that run the loop. Ten core vessels have none while fossil repos hold 60% of vessel docs.
Retire replaced producers: a duplicate shape producer (stateful-ui vs human-surface) keeps absorbing writes nobody reads.
